headline: Soledad Fire Department earns prestigious ISO class two rating.
summary: The Soledad Fire Department earned an ISO Class Two Public Protection Classification (PPC) rating, since September, improving from its previous Class Three rating.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
imageCredit: Image: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
